findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
No CFM was present at time of inspection.  After talking to the PIC, they have spoken to MJ Kellner about signing up for a class through them.  Ensure at least a couple people are certified for future events so there will be at least one person present.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Quat test strips had been recently purchased, but the facility uses chlorine.  Discussed with PIC. Ensure the proper test strips are obtained.  Test strips were left for tonight’s event.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
REPEAT:  Hand washing sink was not supplied with paper towels.  Discussed with PIC who filled paper towel holder on site.  Ensure paper towels are present at all times.

A plastic cup was present in the hand washing sink.  Inspector discarded and discussed with PIC.  Ensure members are only using hand washing sink for washing hands.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Some food splatter present on wall behind stove/fryer station in kitchen. Discussed with PIC. Ensure members clean and sanitize all surfaces after using them. Do not allow grease or food debris to accumulate on surfaces, discussed pest and contamination risk.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. 

Back door in kitchen observed to have a small gap, allowing sunlight in. Discussed with PIC. Ensure external openings remain fully sealed to protect against pest and/or weather entry. Will follow up at next routine.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; 
Handwashing sink at bar area and handwashing sink in the kitchen both lack supply of paper towels. Discussed with PIC. Ensure handwashing sinks remain supplied with soap and towels at all times. Encourage members to wash hands often while using kitchen and/or cooking for events.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed single service plates and coffee filters stored with the food contact surface exposed. Store all single service items properly. The single servive plates and coffee filters were stored properly during the routine inspection to correct the violation. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the faucet of the three compartment sink. Repair plumbing at the three compartment sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the two soda gun nozzles behind the bar to be soiled. Wash, rinse and clean the two soda gun nozzles behind the bar.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled:
(a) fry shack - gaskets on white refrigerator (mold), 
(b) fry shack - fans near east double-doors (dust, dirt), 
(c) fry shack - light bulb sleeves (grease), 
(d) fry shack - cover over grill in southeast corner (grease).
Clean and maintain the aforementioned surfaces, and keep all fry shack surfaces as clean as possible.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Throughout kitchen, drawers holding clean and sanitized utensils are stored with sanitized surface and handles intermingled.  Store sanitized utensils with handles aligned and sanitized surface together.

750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Three baskets of single service spoons, forks, and knives were found in store room, open to the air.  CORRECTED - all three baskets were placed within plastic baggies.  Make sure all single-service items (plates, utensils, cups) are always stored in a way that protects them from contamination.

750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The following floors and floor drains are soiled:
(a) floor drain under/behind kitchen ice machine (mold), 
(b) floor behind east top-loading beer cooler (hard-to-reach spots), 
(c) floor in hard-to-reach corners of north end of bar.
Overall, most floors appear to be very clean, however, make sure the aforementioned floors are cleaned.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
